dsh-web-preview-float 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Web UI 悬浮预览与代码窗口：Google AI Studio 风格的 iframe 预览（宽幅比/分辨率预设、一键放大），VS Code 风格代码窗支持直接编辑，保存需确认并写入会话日志。

posts.en:
dsh-web-preview-float is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-fa21a293c92b2da2cfc6.html
